body.name: measurable totalized empirical Hessian
body.construction: For each \(c\in\mathcal C\), let \(\widehat\lambda_{\min}(c)=\lambda_{\min}(\widehat H_c)\) and set \(\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}}=\widehat H_c+\{h/2-\widehat\lambda_{\min}(c)\}_+I_d\). Use \((\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}})^{-1}\) in every plug-in optimizer influence, and use the resulting common centered influence stack in \(\widehat\Gamma\), \(G_n^*\), and \(Q_n^*\).
